figurative_meaning_en: every moment, from time to time
example_sentences_in_bangla: দণ্ডে দণ্ডে এসে সে আমার খবর নেয়।
দণ্ডে দণ্ডে সে চিঠি লিখে পাঠায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He comes to check on me every moment.
She writes and sends letters from time to time.
note: This idiom emphasizes continuous or frequent occurrence in a poetic or rhythmic manner, common in Bengali prose and poetry.
